metadata.summary: A large-scale dataset of 167,000 patient summaries automatically extracted from PubMed Central (PMC) full-text articles. Each record corresponds to a patient described in case reports / studies, with structured fields (demographics, conditions, procedures, etc.) and links to the source article.
metadata.purpose: Supports patient-level retrieval, patient QA, and clinical NLP.
metadata.avoided_uses: Not intended for real-time clinical decision support; not derived from live EHR systems.

papers.title: PMC-Patients: A Large-scale Dataset of Patient Summaries from PubMed Central

ethics.license: CC BY 4.0 (per Scientific Data article); individual PMC articles retain original copyright and licensing terms.
ethics.privacy_measures: All patient data is de-identified per PMC publishing standards; no direct identifiers retained.
ethics.legal_compliance: Complies with PMC open-access policies and NIH public access requirements.

extraction.notes: 基线卡仅来自 dataset_catalog.xlsx 真实元数据；其余字段需论文/README 或人工补充。

known_limitations: Extracted from publications, not live EHR systems
Lacks structured clinical labels and outcomes
Selection reflects publishability bias (e.g., rare cases over common presentations)
bias_and_limitations.modifications: Yes — automated extraction, normalization, and structuring of free-text patient descriptions.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: Overrepresents rare diseases and atypical presentations due to case report publication norms; underrepresents routine care and diverse sociodemographic groups.
bias_and_limitations.long_tail_classes: Highly skewed distribution: many rare conditions appear only once or few times.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Limited generalizability to real-world EHR populations and non-English clinical settings.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: No explicit subgroup coverage reporting; likely poor coverage of non-English, non-North American/European, and underserved populations.
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: Missing structured outcome data, longitudinal follow-up, and granular demographic variables (e.g., race, ethnicity, socioeconomic status).

benchmarks: PMC-Patients Benchmark (as defined in original paper)
tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Real-time clinical decision support, predictive modeling requiring outcomes or longitudinal data.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Patients described in case reports and studies published in PubMed Central.
data_origin.sampling_strategy: Automated extraction from PMC full-text articles containing patient descriptions; no explicit sampling strategy beyond article availability and structural eligibility.

population.target_population: Patients described in published biomedical case reports and studies.
population.inclusion_criteria: Presence of structured patient description in PMC full-text article.
population.exclusion_criteria: Articles without explicit patient-level narrative or structured summary.
population.missing_groups: Underrepresentation of non-English-speaking populations and patients from low-resource settings due to PMC's English-language and publication bias.

annotation.annotation_method: NLP-based extraction from PMC full-text articles using rule-based and heuristic methods.
annotation.labeling_provenance: Labels derived from unstructured text in PMC articles; no manual curation.
annotation.label_noise_description: Extraction errors due to formatting variability, ambiguous phrasing, and incomplete reporting in source articles.
